summary: Valion Bio, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 15, 2026, disclosing via Exhibit 99.1 a press release announcing completion of an initial feasibility evaluation of LarmorBio's BioScan-NMR platform, reportedly conducted by Velocity Bioworks, generating data supporting continued development of continuous, real-time, non-invasive bioprocess monitoring of cell size, density, and viability. No financial terms, securities, ownership stakes, board recommendations, advisors, or transaction mechanics were stated. This is an ordinary product-development/partnership milestone disclosure rather than a special situation; no deal terms apply, and no risk-arb angle exists.
